sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.5B Model That Beats Larger Models on Agentic Tasks
sources.snippet: MiniCPM5-2B from OpenBMB scores 46.4 on SWE-bench Verified at 2.5B parameters, outperforming 4B-class models on agentic coding tasks. But the quantized build has a 92.1% runaway rate with default settings. Here's how it works, how to run it with MLX and llama.cpp, and the one-flag fix.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B Tops Larger AI Models in OpenBMB Tests - eWeek
sources.snippet: OpenBMB says MiniCPM5-2B tops larger models on its 34-test benchmark table. eWeek finds where the 2.52B-parameter model wins and falls short.
